emails.subject: ⚠️ Action Required: Complete Final Project Milestones & Source Delivery
emails.body:
Dear Team,

Congratulations on reaching the final validation phase of the Pioneer Incubation Program! 

This is a critical reminder that your final software prototype and architecture presentation must be uploaded to the project portal by tomorrow morning, June 25, 2026 at 9:00 AM IST.

Failure to submit by this strict deadline will delay integration. Please make sure all API integrations (Twilio, Gemini API, Firebase) are fully documented in your submissions.

Good luck!

Best regards,
Pioneers Lab Office
